subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Keyboard Navigation Testing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Keyboard Navigation Testing.

hook.text: A user tabs to a modal dialog. The focus jumps behind the modal to invisible elements. They're trapped.

buildup.text: Every interactive element must be reachable, operable, and escapable using only the keyboard.

discovery.text: Tab order should follow the visual layout. Skip links help users jump past repetitive navigation blocks.

twist.text: Focus traps in modals are correct when intentional—focus should stay in the dialog until it's dismissed.

climax.text: Testing the entire app with keyboard only reveals three unreachable buttons and two inescapable dialogs.

punchline.text: Unplug the mouse. Navigate the whole app. Fix what breaks.

quiz.question: What is a correct use of focus trapping?
options: Keep focus inside a modal dialog until it's dismissed
